basic_info.description: Experience the pinnacle of luxury living designed by world renowned architect Gardner Dailey. A stunningly remodeled condo perched in one of SF's most iconic neighborhoods. This exquisite home has been meticulously renovated from top to bottom, blending modern sophistication with timeless elegance. Step inside to discover an open & airy floor plan, designed to maximize light & flow, with premium finishes & attention to detail at every turn. The gourmet kitchen boasts state-of-the-art appliances, sleek cabinetry, & an expansive island perfect for entertaining. Two luxurious en-suite bedrooms & thoughtfully designed living spaces create an ambiance of comfort & style. What truly sets this home apart are the unparalleled views. From the SF skyline to the Bay Bridge, the East Bay hills, & Coit Tower as your front yard, every window frames a postcard-worthy scene. Watch the city light up at night or enjoy the tranquil beauty of the bay from the comfort of your private retreat. Nestled in the heart of Telegraph Hill, this home offers the perfect combination of privacy and proximity. Just steps away from world-class dining, shopping, & iconic landmarks, this residence is an opportunity to live the SF dream! Don't miss your chance to own this breathtaking property that truly has it all!
